# resent message id

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:resentMessageId`](gmeow-resentMessageId.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/resentMessageId>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/email`](../../slices/email.md)
- **Box roles:** [RBox role](../boxes/rbox.md) ([What is this?](../../four-boxes/index.md))

The RFC 5322 Resent-Message-ID header value of a message. Non-functional: a message may carry multiple Resent-Message-ID values if it was resent multiple times. The raw header value remains on [`gmeow:MessageHeader`](../classes/gmeow-MessageHeader.md) ([Principle 4](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-4)).
